recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph capturing two women in mid-dance rehearsal on a wooden studio floor. One woman wears a light-colored lace bodysuit while the other wears a dark fringed two-piece outfit. The background is a utilitarian studio wall with visible floor markings.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic kinetic energy between the two dancing figures
Tonal contrast between the light and dark costumes
Sharp focus on subjects against a slightly textured, flat background
Diagonal lines created by the dancers' limbs and floor markings

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The raised knee of the dancer on the right, creating a central point of action.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A rhythmic flow from left to right, following the outstretched arms and the direction of the dancers' gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space above the heads for typographic placement and open floor space in the foreground.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays defining the studio environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the fringed costume and hair shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright whites in the lace bodysuit and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value range from pure white highlights to deep black shadows.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in negative space above subjects

treatment.shadow: Subtle soft drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight family used for clarity against complex photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides a clean, modern contrast to the vintage imagery.
Humanist qualities match the era of the photo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of two 1950s showgirls in a dance studio. One in a white lace leotard, one in a black fringed bikini. They are barefoot and dancing energetically. The background is a plain studio wall with wooden floors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white sans-serif text in the top right corner. Ensure the text is legible against the gray wall background.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Are the dancers' poses dynamic and mid-action?
Is the text positioned in the upper negative space?

avoid: Motion blur that obscures the subjects
Overly dark shadows that lose detail

postGenerationChecks: Check for five fingers on each hand
Verify the floor markings look like chalk or tape
Ensure the text does not overlap the dancers' hair
Confirm the lighting feels like a single-source studio flash
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage studio photography + dynamic dance pose + high-contrast monochrome + bold sans-serif header.
